evidence_items.explanation: The authors tested four models, including Claude 3.5 Sonnet, on 70 Java commits, clearing context and repeating identical prompts five times at temperature zero. The reported variation in code-review assessments supports the possibility asserted; the precise experiment dates are not supplied.

This experiment shows that changes to the serving implementation can make repeated completions identical. It counters an interpretation that variation is unavoidable, but does not contradict Zitron's narrower statement that variation can occur.
